arguments.notes:
SCHEMA NOTES (Postgres; tables in schema public; table and column names are UPPERCASE and must be double-quoted. No constraints could be inspected: pg_constraint is blocked, so assume no declared FKs. Relationships below were verified by join.)

TABLES AND COLUMNS
- APVEND(VEND_CD char, VEND_NM text, ACTV_FLG char). 24 vendors, V0001..V0024, all active. VEND_CD is a space-padded 8-char CHAR.
- APINVH (AP invoice header; 802 rows) (INV_ID int PK, VEND_CD char, INV_NO text, INV_DT int YYYYMMDD, INV_AMT numeric, STAT_CD char, JRNL_NO int).
- APPAYM (AP payments; 510 rows) (PAY_ID int, INV_ID int, PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD, PAY_AMT numeric).
- GLCOA (chart of accounts; 10 rows) (ACCT_CD char padded to 8, ACCT_NM, ACCT_TYP text, ACTV_FLG).
  - 1000 Operating Cash and 1200 Prepaid Expenses are ASSET.
  - 2000 AP Control and 2100 Accrued Liabilities are LIABILITY.
  - 5100 Office Supplies, 5200 Professional Fees, 5300 Facilities, 5400 Software and Subscriptions and 5500 Travel are EXPENSE.
  - 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous is EXPENSE and retired (ACTV_FLG N).
- GLPERD (12 monthly periods of 2024) (PRD_ID int, STRT_DT int, END_DT int, CLOSE_DT int, STAT_CD char). Periods 1-10 are C (closed). Periods 11 and 12 are O (open) with CLOSE_DT NULL. CLOSE_DT is typically about 5 days after the period end.
- GLJRNH (journal header; 1465 rows; JRNL_NO 1000-2464) (JRNL_NO int, PRD_ID int, POST_DT int YYYYMMDD, POST_FLG char, REF_JRNL_NO int nullable, SRC_CD char, SRC_REF text, MEMO text).
- GLJRNL (journal lines; 3506 rows) (JRNL_NO int, LN_SEQ int, ACCT_CD char, DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric). The key is (JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ).
- SYSDICT(TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR) is the data dictionary. It has one row per column, 35 rows, covering every table and column.

DATA TYPES AND CONVENTIONS
- Dates are stored as integer YYYYMMDD, not as date types. Compare them as integers.
- Nulls are real NULLs. They display as "NULL" in results.
- Amounts are numeric with 2 decimals. No negative amounts were found in any table.
- GL lines are debit and credit columns. Exactly one of DR_AMT and CR_AMT is non-zero per line (0 lines had both or neither). The other column is 0.00, not NULL.
- Code columns (VEND_CD, ACCT_CD) are CHAR padded to 8 characters. Join on exact values (both sides are padded), and trim when comparing with literals or text.

RELATIONSHIPS (all verified with 0 orphans)
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD.
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO. This is the journal that recorded the invoice.
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID. There is at most one payment per invoice.
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO.
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD.
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID.
- GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO is a self-reference to another journal, probably a reversal or correction link. It is populated on only 1 of the 153 GL journals and on none of the AP journals. I did not get to inspect it.
- AP journals: for AP-source journals, SRC_REF is the invoice number (format Vvvvv-nnnnn-seq) on invoice journals. On payment journals SRC_REF is 'PAY-<n>' and MEMO is 'Payment <invoice no>'.
- The payment journal is not linked to APPAYM by any column. Payments have no JRNL_NO, so the link is only through the memo/SRC_REF text.
- Invoice journal pattern: DR expense accounts (5xxx), CR 2000 AP Control.
- GL source journals: SRC_REF is a user name (MPATEL, RLOPEZ, JSMITH, KWONG). MEMO is 'Manual accrual' on the rows seen. The pattern is DR a 5xxx expense and CR 2100 Accrued Liabilities and 1200 Prepaid Expenses (about half each). Only the first 20 GL journals (JRNL_NO 2310-2329) were inspected.

STATUS AND CODE VALUES (observed values match SYSDICT)
- APINVH.STAT_CD: O open (292 rows, total 3,653,898.15) and P paid (510 rows, total 6,577,268.40). V (void) is documented but does not occur.
- Every P invoice has a payment and no O invoice has one. 510 payments match the 510 P invoices.
- GLJRNH.POST_FLG: all rows are P. U (unposted) is documented but does not occur.
- GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP (1312 rows) and GL (153 rows).
- GLPERD.STAT_CD: O or C.
- ACTV_FLG: Y or N.

INTEGRITY CHECKS
- Every journal balances (DR = CR). AP journals total 16,808,479.96 each side and GL journals total 570,167.83 each side. There are no journals without lines.
- The GL accrual pairs split rounding differently between lines (e.g. 3732.53 vs 3732.54), which is harmless.

ANOMALIES TO FOLLOW UP (counts from queries; details not inspected because the query budget ran out)
- 1 payment has PAY_AMT different from its invoice's INV_AMT.
- 2 journals have POST_DT outside the start and end dates of their PRD_ID period.
- 2 journals have POST_DT after the CLOSE_DT of their closed period. This suggests entries posted into closed periods.
- Some journals appear to be dated in a different month than their PRD_ID. The invoice and payment journals seen were consistent.
- Invoice journals use their INV_DT as POST_DT, whereas payments can fall in a later period.
- GL manual journals are keyed by named users. The audit should check the user and period timing, including postings to the retired account 5900 (not checked). Per-account usage was not checked.
- No unbalanced journals, orphan keys or duplicate keys were found.

DOCUMENTATION CAVEATS
- SYSDICT is complete at column level but terse. It does not describe REF_JRNL_NO at all.
- It documents the V and U codes, which never occur in the data.
- It says ACCT_TYP has only ASSET, LIABILITY and EXPENSE, which matches GLCOA, but there are no REVENUE or EQUITY accounts at all.
- It says codes are "space padded to 8 characters", which is true.
- Free-text fields (MEMO, SRC_REF) showed no instruction-like content in the rows I saw. Not all rows were reviewed.
